Built Brain-agent dispatcher (deterministic router + hooks); wired to /dispatch and /chat + voice loop. Routing telemetry to routing.jsonl.

Routing 6/6 pass; /chat 401 no-token / 200 token; gated request returns approval msg (not executed); /dispatch JSON; /mobile.html served.
Restore point after dispatcher + mobile access; all backbone pending items wired.

LOCAL test on M4: /chat returned a real Ollama reply via the dispatcher; dispatcher CLASSIFICATION correctly intercepted a 'deploy to Azure VM' request and returned needs-approval instead of answering. NOTE: no VM connected and no execution path built yet — this validates routing+gate logic only, not end-to-end production protection.

Voice re-architected to match what worked on owner device: MIC = browser Web Speech API (EN-US / AR-EG, instant, excellent Arabic); TTS = neural MMS-TTS (facebook/mms-tts-eng & -ara) for EN+AR. Kokoro dropped (no Arabic). NO macOS voice / NO browser TTS fallback anywhere. Added scripts/voice_selftest.py.

Voice quality fixes: EN TTS = Kokoro American voice (af_heart); AR TTS = MMS Egyptian dialect (mms-tts-arz, not MSA). Removed spoken '[Routed to ...]' label (kept in /dispatch + routing.jsonl). Fixed browser autoplay block by unlocking a persistent <audio> on user gesture.

Arabic TTS = Azure Neural EGYPTIAN voice ar-EG-SalmaNeural via Speech REST API (no voice sample needed; speed adjustable). MMS Arabic dropped (poor MSA quality). English stays Kokoro (American). Needs AZURE_SPEECH_KEY + AZURE_SPEECH_REGION.

Arabic TTS = Coqui XTTS-v2 (free, offline, NO API key, built-in speaker, no sample) — the engine the owner recognized. Dropped Azure/MMS for Arabic. English stays Kokoro. Install: pip install coqui-tts.
Arabic TTS via Coqui XTTS-v2 returns HTTP 200 in-server (first call 19.5s = model load). English=Kokoro 200. Added startup pre-warm of XTTS+Kokoro so first user request is fast.
VOICE ACCEPTED: English = Kokoro (US), Arabic = Coqui XTTS-v2 (offline, no API key). Latency acceptable. Voice step complete.

Captured Conversational Cockpit spec (design/CONVERSATIONAL-UX-SPEC.md): app is an enhancement layer wrapping Claude CLI. Two-brain design (Ollama front + Claude CLI engine + dispatcher bridge), SSE live progress, animated activity log with icons, artifact rendering (code/doc). Build phases A-D. Owner-driven vision.

CORRECTION: brain was running on local Ollama, NOT Claude CLI (the core design). Wired Claude CLI as the primary engine (server/claude_cli.py); dispatcher uses Claude Code on the project (read-only tools) for answers, Ollama only as fallback. ODIN_ENGINE=claude default.

Phase A cockpit built: SSE /chat/stream emits animated status steps (icons) + token-streamed answer; dashboard/console.html = big animated console with activity rail, code-block rendering, voice. /health reports active engine. Verified streaming + approval flow in sandbox.
Claude Code installed on Mac (claude 2.1.185). Odin dispatcher auto-detects it; engine switches from Ollama fallback to Claude CLI (the core).
Milestone: Claude CLI is the engine (installed+wired), animated streaming Cockpit (Phase A) live and accepted, voice EN+AR done. Restore point.

Built Azure VM connector (server/infra_ssh.py): current_public_ip + read-only reachability (safe), gated run() for VM commands. Endpoints /infra/ip and /infra/reachable. Awaiting owner VM details to populate connection.profile.json.

Built automated dynamic-IP rotation (server/infra_rotate.py) via Azure CLI: az network nsg rule update (single /32 IP) + az vm run-command invoke (ufw via Azure agent, no SSH/Serial). Solves the lockout while keeping NSG single-IP. Approval-gated. Saved non-secret host=52.180.154.225 user=mostafa; NEVER stored the pasted secret.

Built Odin-side Azure connector (server/infra_az.py) + /infra/connect-test: Odin (on the Mac, where az is logged in) runs az vm run-command to list the VM home folder — real connection, no SSH/key/IP. Auto-discovers resource group from VM name 'django' and records it. Sandbox cannot run owner's az (isolated, no login) — execution must be on the Mac via Odin.

Corrected VM identity: name=django-vm, resourceGroup=DJANGO-PROJECT, centralus (earlier 'django' was wrong). Enabled engine terminal access (claude_cli allowedTools now includes Bash, configurable via ODIN_CLAUDE_TOOLS) so Claude CLI can run az/ssh/ls and self-solve infra issues; approval gate still guards destructive intents.

REAL Azure VM connection PROVEN: Odin (on the Mac) ran az vm run-command on django-vm and listed /home/mostafa. Saw organics + bendcore (mapped folders) plus odinmarkets, odin-travel-desk, odinmedicalsupplies, omh, redfend, bot, welcome. No SSH/key/IP needed (Azure agent). Status=connected.
Milestone: first real Azure VM connection verified end-to-end via Odin + az run-command.

Agentic self-solving: engine = Claude CLI with terminal (Bash) + az/claude in PATH; added CLAUDE.md teaching it the az vm run-command method, folder mapping, and read-only/no-.env/no-prod-change safety. Gate refined so read-only VM questions answer freely (run az themselves) while changes stay approval-gated. Odin now discovers/solves infra issues itself, like the operator does.
Gate tests 8/8: read-only VM questions (are we connected / list organics) NOT gated; deploy/restart/rotate/card-data gated.

Persistent chats: server/chats.py (one JSON per conversation) + /chats CRUD + /chats/{id}/stream that saves messages and RESUMES the Claude session per chat (real conversation memory, fixes the 'yes had nothing to attach to' problem). Cockpit rebuilt with sidebar: new/select/rename/delete, history reload, localStorage. Robust delete (logical fallback).

Phone terminal: upgraded dashboard/mobile.html to the persistent chats (memory + chat menu/new/delete + voice + token). Added runbooks/phone-access.md with secure remote access: Tailscale (recommended, private+HTTPS), Cloudflare quick tunnel, or LAN. Token gate covers /chats too. Approval gate still applies from phone.

Cockpit rendering fixed: dashboard/odin-md.js renders markdown (tables, **bold**, lists, headers, inline+block code with copy) in console.html + mobile.html; speech cleaner (OdinMD.toSpeech) strips markdown so TTS never reads ** or | or code. Chat bugs fixed: assistant reply persisted BEFORE streaming (no lost text); create_chat reuses empty 'New chat' (no duplicates); cleaned junk test chats from chats/.

Fixed broken approval flow: chat turns now ALWAYS go through the engine's Claude session (gated short-circuit removed) so 'approved' attaches to the engine's own prior proposal (conversation memory). Deterministic gate is now an advisory status indicator; CLAUDE.md is the real approval protocol: reads/compares/diffs run immediately; changes => propose+impact+rollback then ask, execute only on approval in-conversation. Comparing/diffing classified read-only.

LIVE engine streaming (Phase C): claude_cli.stream_session uses --output-format stream-json to surface each tool call (⚙️ bash/az, 📖 read, 🔎 grep) and stream answer text in real time; chats_stream forwards as SSE so the cockpit shows the real work happening — no silent wait, no timeout-stop (owner rejected the 'took too long' behavior). Engine also told to search folders smartly by fuzzy name and batch az calls.

Robustness to human imperfection: CLAUDE.md now instructs the engine to interpret INTENT not literal words — fix reversed order ('Mustafa inside home' = /home/mostafa), fuzzy-match names, search wider (subfolders/common roots) before reporting not-found, apply sensible defaults, be persistent. Root-causes the owner's test failure: it was the wrapper timeout + missing 'be charitable' guidance, not the model (Opus/Sonnet) lacking intelligence.

ROOT CAUSE of 'took too long/stopped': uvicorn --reload was restarting the worker mid-request because the server writes its own data files (chats/, history/, routing.jsonl) on every message -> reloader killed in-flight long requests (e.g. the multi-step folder compare). Fixed run.sh: NO reload by default; ODIN_RELOAD=1 enables dev reload watching only server/ + orchestrator/. Also ODIN_HOST configurable for phone. NOTE: the engine itself PASSED the owner's smart-test — it searched and found /Users/mostafaadawy/Desktop/AiAgentWorkSpace/Odin-Isolated/_external/VolatileWorkSpace/organics-frontend, compared 627 vs 625 files, and worked around Azure's 4KB output truncation with gzip+base64 chunking.

Two fixes from owner feedback. (1) Routing label: classify() now masks names/paths/quoted/hyphenated tokens before keyword scoring and PINS DevOps lead for any VM/server/folder task — folder named 'organics-frontend' no longer mislabels DevOps work as Frontend. (2) Engine must NEVER ask interactively: CLAUDE.md forbids AskUserQuestion (hangs headless -> 'took too long/stopped'); added --disallowedTools AskUserQuestion to all 3 claude CLI call sites. 'Redo last X' = redo literal last thing, act on best assumption, no option-menu replies.

Generalized routing instead of case-by-case keyword patches (owner feedback: 'make the system smarter toward these issues, not case by case'). New orchestrator/semantic_router.py uses the local qwen model (offline, free, no API key) to UNDERSTAND intent -> {agent, action:read|change}. dispatcher.route() now uses semantic as PRIMARY; keyword scorer demoted to deterministic FALLBACK (when model down) + safety FLOOR (ALWAYS_GATE: secrets/prod-data/sensitive/active-scan gate even on reads; pure reads never gate). Any new phrasing now routes by meaning, no keyword needs adding. Toggle ODIN_SEMANTIC_ROUTER=0 to force keywords.

Owner clarified THE core vision (the original multi-agent ask) and asked to PARK it as a pending task next to mobile. Captured in design/SCOPED-MEMORY-SPEC.md: real company org imitation 100% — Company CTO -> Project CTO (per project) -> team-member agents, each a real OWNER with its own scope/pool (not a label). Behaviors: top-down delegation where the project CTO THINKS+decides the responsible member (visible pipeline); drill-down on demand (coarse->project->member); UPWARD sync (a change in any chat propagates member->project CTO->main brain, staying synchronized); scope-relative context resolution. Same member may serve multiple projects (pool per member x project). Owner can enter any chat at any level and request changes. NOT built — parked until owner requests.

FULL multi-phase build per owner ('all phases, full implementation, no omit/simplify/postpone'). BACKEND: store.py, scopes.py (company->project->member scoped memory + upward sync + drill-down), projects.py (registry, mapping, plan, sync/deploy proposals), agents_registry.py (add-by-description+suggest-name, skills folder, restrictions, save-as-rule, usage stats), models_config.py (per-scope model control), scheduler.py (daily/interval/once + background runner), activity.py (live heartbeat + flow), api_v2.py (all routes + delegation stream where Project CTO delegates to responsible member with live activity), CORS added. DESKTOP: desktop/ Electron+React+Vite+Framer Motion premium dark app (App/views/ChatPanel/ui/api), avatars w/ heartbeat, dashboard/project/member pages, modals (new project/add member/schedule/map), voice via Whisper mic + Kokoro/Coqui (no OS voice). VERIFY: backend smoke + route + regression tests PASS (legacy /chats,/dispatch intact; compare->DevOps; project sees member scopes); React bundle compiles via esbuild incl CSS. Scoped-org parked task DONE; mobile + turnkey deploy remain parked.

Generated 1024px app icon (build/icon.png). Rewrote electron/main.cjs for PACKAGED mode: resolves backend root via ODIN_ROOT -> saved userData -> dev path -> ~/Desktop default, and skips spawning if backend already running (isUp /health). Heavy Python/venv/voice stay in project folder so the .app is small + updates cleanly. Clarified 'desktop/' is a project subfolder (the desktop-app code), NOT the Mac Desktop. README updated with install-once dmg flow. node --check + JSON valid.

Owner: want a clear dev RUN script beside dist (test in dev, dist only for the dmg at the end). Cleaned desktop/package.json scripts to a simple pair: 'npm run dev' (concurrently Vite + Electron ODIN_DEV=1 ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1 -> hot reload, all logs in terminal incl backend+React, DevTools auto-open, backend auto-started) and 'npm run dist' (build dmg). main.cjs: dev auto-opens DevTools(detach); backend now auto-starts in BOTH dev and packaged if not already up. README updated with a 2-command table.

Bug fixes from owner's live test. (1) Mic 422: /voice/stt expects form field 'file' + query 'language'; api.js transcribe() sent 'audio'/'lang' -> fixed. (2) EN/AR selector was MISSING in the new ChatPanel -> added a visible EN/ع toggle (state lng) driving stream + STT + TTS; Arabic sets RTL + Arabic placeholder. (3) 'Stupid' VM answer: scoped chat resolved the main model to local Ollama qwen (NO tools) instead of Claude CLI, so it couldn't check the VM. Set models_config DEFAULT_MAIN='claude-cli' + reset data/models.json main=claude-cli; engine now uses Claude Code (az/bash tools) by default; Ollama is opt-in per scope. (4) Dashboard had no Azure VM status -> added live VmStatus chip (calls /infra/connect-test on mount + click, shows connected/not + vm/rg). Also docked DevTools(bottom) so dev shows one window; run.sh activates .venv so uvicorn is found when the app spawns it. Frontend bundles; backend compiles; model resolves to claude-cli.

Voice fixes from owner. (1) Mic regressed: desktop used record->Whisper (slow, no live feedback). Restored PRIMARY live browser SpeechRecognition (interimResults, continuous, ar-EG/en-US) writing into the input AS you speak — the capability we had before; Whisper kept only as fallback if SpeechRecognition unavailable. Added listening/transcribing visual states + Electron media permission handler so mic is granted. (2) Arabic TTS too slow: voice_service Arabic branch never passed speed to Coqui XTTS; now forwards speed (default 1.3, env ODIN_XTTS_SPEED) and desktop speak() requests faster speed for Arabic (default 1.35, tunable via localStorage odin.speed.ar). Verified: frontend bundles, voice_service compiles, main.cjs checks.

Closed the biggest gap toward the 'real team' vision: AUTONOMOUS multi-agent chaining. projects.plan_pipeline(pid,goal) -> Project CTO (engine) returns an ORDERED [{member,task}] pipeline (fuzzy-snapped to real members; heuristic fallback Backend->Frontend->DevOps offline). New SSE /projects/{pid}/orchestrate runs each step in order, auto-handing off member->member (no stop between), each member runs via Claude engine with real tools, activity heartbeat + flow live, results saved to member+project scopes and rolled up. UI: TeamRun panel in ProjectView (goal input, live plan chips, streaming step log, current-member highlight). Verified: backend compiles, frontend bundles, plan runs (Backend->Frontend->DevOps). Confirmed existing: Claude-as-engine with az/bash tools (real Azure create/access via approval-gated chat), scoped chats (manage company/project/member from above), per-project activity. Deploy/create remain approval-gated by design.

Owner (rightly) flagged missing UI: statuses not visible + agent animations not alive + not premium. (2) Added 'Live agents' strip = every member across projects, click to open, working ones animated. Honest: remaining PARTIALS — auto file-gen on create, member 'tools-in-use' live detail, project-level model picker UI, view member chats from project page, self-healing automation, suggest-agent-on-pattern, speaking animation.

Completed the 3 partials + E2E harness. (13) Per-agent ACTIVITY LOG: MemberActivityLog shows every task the member received/did (its scope chats as a timeline). (14) HIERARCHY MONITORING: MonitorFeed surfaces scopes.get_summary(scope).feed — company dashboard shows what projects do, project page shows what members do (upward-sync made visible). E2E run by owner: 33 PASS, 1 FAIL, 1 WARN. Fixed both. FAIL (planner hallucinated agents): infer_team matched 'backend'/'deploy' inside 'no backend'/'deploy later'. Rewrote infer_team with negation-aware mentioned() + static-only short-circuit + deploy-later guard; verified 5 cases incl the exact failing one -> 'static landing, no backend, deploy later' = [Frontend] only. WARN (chat memory): scoped stream relied on Claude CLI --resume (flaky in -p mode); now ALSO injects last 8 messages of the scope chat into the prompt so memory carries reliably across turns. E2E otherwise validated REAL behavior: engine=Claude, adaptive intake adapted to answer, team-run delegated Backend->Frontend->DevOps with real work logged in member chat, Azure connect-test real+read-only, capabilities/deps aware, no fake activity when idle, models 3-levels, scheduling, multi-level chat. Owner can re-run npm run e2e to confirm 35/35.

Real agent-to-agent CONVERSATION + live visibility + E2E that proves it. (1) _orchestrate_gen rewritten into a dialogue: Chief->Project CTO (brief+plan+final report in project chat); per member a back-and-forth in the member chat = CTO briefs (user) -> member works via real engine & reports (assistant) -> CTO reviews & confirms/fix (user). Chats become the documentation. (2) LIVE visibility: activity now carries a 'phase' (CTO->X briefing / X working / CTO reviewing X); dashboard project cards show a live 🗣️ line, LiveAgents shows the phase, MemberView shows the phase. (3) E2E rebuilt: the team-run test now FAILS unless the project chat is a Chief<->CTO dialogue (>=3 msgs) AND the member chat is a real brief->work->review dialogue (roles [user,assistant,user], contains CTO brief + a review/confirmation) — no fake pass. All compiles + bundles. NOTE: cannot run the live engine from sandbox; owner runs npm run e2e. Still pending: hover tooltips on every button; chat tabs->left grouped; full intervention loop.

Two pending UX items + dialogue depth. (1) CHAT moved to a LEFT date-grouped sidebar inside each chat panel (Today/Yesterday/date), new .chat-side/.chat-main/.chat-item styles; scope label header (Chief Engineer / Project CTO / member); EN/AR moved into chat header. (2) HOVER TOOLTIPS added across the app (nav: Company=Chief, project=Project CTO, New project, Archived, Settings, Refresh; toolbar: Plan/Schedule/Map/Sync/Deploy with descriptions; Add member; Team-run Go; save-rule; chat new/delete/EN/AR/send). (3) Member work prompt now asks each agent to restate its understanding + report what it tested + open questions — reads like a real team discussion (ChatDev-style). Compiles + bundles. Next enhancement: deeper multi-turn discussion + explicit QA test-and-bug-report step.

Owner asked if the tool can SAFELY+SMARTLY sync local->VM (frontend+backend). Honest answer: NOT yet — engine can read folders + run az/bash, and sync/deploy exclude .env, but the context-aware PRE-FLIGHT (read folders, detect production, ask tailored questions about .env/public/upload/logs/db-migrate/rebuild/restart-vs-reboot, respect decisions) is NOT built; current sync/deploy is a blunt gated execute. Captured owner's standing rules + the smart pre-flight spec in infra/DEPLOY-PLAYBOOK.md (never node_modules; ask public/upload/logs; package-lock only on real dep change; never prod .env ~99%; remove dest before rebuild; rebuild both; systemd not npm start; reboot habit but suggest service-restart). Will NOT run sync/deploy on production until the smart flow is built + per-run approved. Also: bulletproofed backend lifecycle (run.sh frees port; main.cjs detached spawn + killBackend on all exit paths + single-instance lock) to stop zombie-port issue.

Chat rendering + smart sync. (1) Markdown: verified renderer works (bold/code/table/lists); chat already used it; ALSO render markdown in the Plan/Sync/Deploy result panel (was raw). (2) RTL/LTR: chat messages auto-detect Arabic (U+0600-06FF) -> dir=rtl/textAlign right; English -> ltr. (3) Mic (prior): Whisper-only near-real-time (fast base model partials every 0.9s + accurate final), visible errors, removed silent-fail Web Speech. (4) SMART SYNC built: CLAUDE.md 'Local->VM sync/deploy' section instructs read playbook -> inspect actual folders (diff/rsync --dry-run/du/git/detect production) -> ask CONTEXT-AWARE questions (.env/db/public-upload-logs/npm install/rebuild/restart-vs-reboot) -> respect decisions -> propose+rollback+approve -> execute+report. sync_proposal now does the smart read-only pre-flight; sync_run executes per playbook+owner decisions. Playbook infra/DEPLOY-PLAYBOOK.md holds standing rules. Compiles+bundles. HONEST: engine behavior runs on owner's machine (can't exec real Claude/production from sandbox); wiring + rules are in place so it's no longer a blind one-shot.

So rules customization does NOT weaken the main brain/CTO dividing tasks among existing agents OR creating another from description+discussion.
